name: Meraki
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, Layer 3 topology, alerts synced into Actions, a Meraki agent in AI Canvas, shared Workflows, and cross-launch.
staysInController: Dashboard configuration and Meraki roles stay in the Meraki dashboard.

name: Catalyst Center
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, topology, notifications, and AI Canvas questions on assurance, compliance, and software images, connected through Meraki.
staysInController: On-premises automation and assurance; version 3.3.1 support is Controlled Availability.

name: Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, topology, notifications, and AI Canvas questions on tunnel health, circuits, and application experience.
staysInController: SD-WAN policy and templates; Cloud-Pro deployments are planned, not supported.

name: Nexus Dashboard
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, topology, notifications, fabric-health questions in AI Canvas, and a read-only Live Protect view.
staysInController: Fabric configuration and Live Protect shield deployment, reached by cross-launch.

name: Nexus Hyperfabric
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, topology, notifications, and AI Canvas questions on resource discovery, diagnostics, and endpoint search.
staysInController: Fabric design and deployment; data sharing must be enabled in Hyperfabric.

name: Cisco Intersight
managesViaCloudControl: Compute inventory, topology, notifications, license visibility, and AI Assistant questions on server health and faults.
staysInController: Server profiles, policies, and firmware; SaaS US-East only, no Virtual Appliance.
sourceTitle: Cisco Intersight Integration with Cisco Cloud Control FAQ

name: Security: Secure Firewall
managesViaCloudControl: Firewall inventory, topology, notifications, and AI Canvas questions on VPN status, health, and policy analysis.
staysInController: Firewall policy authoring and deployment; one Security tenant per environment.

name: Security: Secure Access
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, alerts and correlated actions, license visibility, and AI Canvas activity and reporting questions.
staysInController: Access policy stays in Secure Access.

name: Cisco Identity (ISE, Duo, external identity sources)
managesViaCloudControl: One view of identity posture and risk from ISE, Duo, Okta, and Active Directory, with ISE assets in Inventory.
staysInController: ISE and Duo policy; external sources need Duo Advantage+ or ISE Advantage+.
status: GA (US); Identity for AI Canvas is Beta
sourceTitle: Cisco Identity in Cloud Control (Identity Intelligence Knowledge Base)

name: ThousandEyes
managesViaCloudControl: Inventory, notifications, license visibility, and AI Canvas questions on outages and test root cause.
staysInController: Test configuration; no topology data; one ThousandEyes tenant per environment.

name: Splunk (Cloud Platform, ITSI, Observability Cloud)
managesViaCloudControl: Single sign-on, cross-launch, Splunk data and skills in AI Canvas, Agent Observability, and license visibility.
staysInController: Indexes, searches, and detections; needs Splunk Cloud 10.5+ on US Commercial AWS.

name: Collaboration Control Hub (Webex)
managesViaCloudControl: Collaboration inventory plus AI Canvas questions on meeting quality, calling, and room devices.
staysInController: Collaboration administration; no topology or notification data in Cloud Control.

name: Cisco Spaces
managesViaCloudControl: Spaces Connectors in Inventory and Topology, health alerts, and dashboard cross-launch.
staysInController: Location services and apps; Spaces-only single sign-on is not supported.

name: Cisco IQ
managesViaCloudControl: Listed as a connected product at US GA; TAC support cases can be opened from Cloud Control.
staysInController: Lifecycle insights and playbooks; one-click device action was announced October 26, 2026.
sourceTitle: A new chapter for IT operations: Cisco Cloud Control is now generally available for U.S. customers

name: Inventory
managesViaCloudControl: One AI-searchable asset list synced from connected products every 5 or 60 minutes.
staysInController: Inactive assets drop after 3 days; source products keep their own records.

name: Topology
managesViaCloudControl: One map of sites and devices across controllers, with Layer 1 to Layer 3 views and AI Insights.
staysInController: Data center and compute relationships show at Layer 1 and 2 only.

name: Actions
managesViaCloudControl: Related alerts grouped into one issue with a possible cause, a recommendation, and supporting evidence.
staysInController: Acting on an alert still needs permission in the underlying controller.

name: AI Assistant
managesViaCloudControl: Natural-language answers and guided tasks across connected products, scoped to one environment per product.
staysInController: Uses only data the signed-in user is authorized to see.
sourceTitle: Cisco Cloud Control AI Canvas and AI Assistant (documentation)

name: AI Canvas
managesViaCloudControl: A shared workspace where product agents investigate in parallel and people review evidence and approve next steps.
staysInController: Shared-link collaborators get edit rights; model training is on by default.
sourceTitle: Cisco Cloud Control AI Canvas and AI Assistant (documentation)

name: Deep Reasoning (Reasoning mode)
managesViaCloudControl: Builds an investigation plan the operator approves, then returns evidence-backed findings and stated limitations.
staysInController: Workflows cannot run in Reasoning mode.
status: Available (Cisco Connect deck); Beta in June 2026
sourceTitle: Networking for the Agentic Era (Cisco Connect St. Louis)

name: Cisco product agents in AI Canvas
managesViaCloudControl: Operators pick which product agents handle a prompt, such as the Meraki or ThousandEyes agent.
staysInController: Agents shown depend on product entitlements and configured integrations.

name: Cisco Agentic Workflows
managesViaCloudControl: Reusable automations with approval tasks, run manually, automatically, or by API, and launched from AI Canvas.
staysInController: On-premises targets need a remote target appliance; the Workflows agent is Beta.
status: GA (US); Workflows agent in AI Canvas is Beta

name: Agentic Actions for networking
managesViaCloudControl: One place to see agent reasoning, recommended actions, approvals, and resolution tracking for network incidents.
staysInController: Autonomy controls by action type and change window are still roadmap.
sourceTitle: Powering Partner Potential in a World of Agentic AI

name: Expanded Experience Metrics
managesViaCloudControl: Turns network telemetry into user-experience indicators for wired, wireless, and now application performance.
staysInController: Beta sign-up required.
sourceTitle: Powering Partner Potential in a World of Agentic AI

name: Digital Twin
managesViaCloudControl: Emulates devices, topology, and configurations so changes can be validated before production.
staysInController: No status update found since the June 2026 announcement.
sourceTitle: The Agentic Workplace Runs on Cisco

name: Autonomous Agentic Loop
managesViaCloudControl: Agents sense, diagnose, remediate, validate, and deploy within customer-defined controls.
staysInController: Announced as future capability; human approval remains the documented path today.
sourceTitle: From signal to action: The next step in Cisco AgenticOps

name: Cloud Control Studio: Agent Builder
managesViaCloudControl: Build custom agents and skills in natural language and connect third-party tools through connectors or MCP.
staysInController: No GA, beta, or Controlled Availability statement found as of November 13, 2026.
sourceTitle: Agent Builder in Cloud Control Studio

name: Cloud Control Studio: App Builder
managesViaCloudControl: Build and publish Cloud Control apps from natural-language prompts with OpenAI Codex built in.
staysInController: No GA, beta, or Controlled Availability statement found as of November 13, 2026.
sourceTitle: From an Idea to a Live App on Cisco, in Minutes

name: Cloud Control Marketplace
managesViaCloudControl: A catalog for certified Cisco and partner agents, apps, and integrations.
staysInController: ServiceNow, BlueCat, Infoblox, and Atlassian integrations are available today outside Marketplace status.
sourceTitle: Agent Builder in Cloud Control Studio (product page)

name: Cisco Model Foundry
managesViaCloudControl: A platform service to discover, evaluate, fine-tune, and run Cisco's purpose-built models on your own data.
staysInController: Partners get access first; press reports GA planned for June 2027.
sourceTitle: Cisco Expands Partner Opportunity with New Cisco 360 Program Updates (press release)

name: MCP servers for networking platforms
managesViaCloudControl: A standard way for AI agents to read live network data from Cisco networking platforms.
staysInController: Deck labels Catalyst Center and Meraki Beta, ThousandEyes GA.
status: Announced; Beta or GA by product
sourceTitle: Cisco Expands Partner Opportunity with New Cisco 360 Program Updates (press release)

name: Live Protect visibility (Nexus)
managesViaCloudControl: A read-only view of vulnerability exposure and shield status for supported Nexus switches.
staysInController: Shields are deployed in Nexus Dashboard by cross-launch.

name: Licensing
managesViaCloudControl: License usage, balance, and expiration for Meraki, Intersight, ThousandEyes, Splunk Cloud, and Secure Access.
staysInController: License purchase and assignment stay in each product.

name: RBAC and audit log
managesViaCloudControl: Two-layer role-based access and an audit log of changes, with every action logged by user and time.
staysInController: Product roles are unchanged; Cloud Control never widens product access.

name: Cisco AI Defense
managesViaCloudControl: Named as the policy enforcement and runtime scanning layer for agents built in Cloud Control Studio.
staysInController: Not a connected product tile; AI Defense remains a separate product.
sourceTitle: Agent Builder in Cloud Control Studio
